agent_explanation: Large fast body (r~1.19, speed~42) grazing the bottom tip of a minimum-thickness (0.1) vertical wall penetrates up to 0.388 instead of bouncing/sliding. Frames 7-10 show the disc clipping the wall's lower end. Per-step x-travel ~0.64 is resolved with ~22 substeps (~0.03/substep), yet the corner/side contact produces no effective push-out: distance goes +0.93 -> +0.27 -> -0.39 while vx stays -40.89, i.e. no impulse/deflection at the corner. Likely circle-vs-thin-box corner normal/correction failure under fast grazing impact.
